headline: BHP Outlines Up to $17.4 Billion Capex Plan to Double South Australian Copper Output
summary: Mining giant BHP announced investment plans of $13.6 billion to $17.4 billion to double copper production to 650,000 tonnes in South Australia.
why: BHP is the world's largest diversified miner; major copper expansions support global electrification metal supplies.
